en.headline: EMSD finds missing lift door components in 186 more buildings, total reaches 338
en.dek: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has completed checks on all Taizoom-installed lifts, identifying 338 buildings lacking fire-safety door frame parts.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said on Monday that inspections had identified missing door frame components in lifts at 186 additional buildings installed by Taizoom Elevator, bringing the cumulative total to 338.

According to the department’s latest sample check results as of 2pm on Monday, all 338 buildings where the components were absent are private properties whose lifts were fitted by Taizoom, apart from the two earlier Tenants Purchase Scheme estates. The department stated it has completed inspections of buildings under Taizoom’s responsibility and will continue checking works by other registered contractors.

The missing components form part of the fire-resistant door assemblies intended to limit the spread of flames and smoke. The department has previously said the lifts can still operate safely, while ordering the contractor to install the missing parts at its own cost.

zh.headline: 機電署再發現186幢大廈升降機缺門框組件 累計338幢
zh.dek: 機電署完成臺中電梯所有安裝工程檢查，共338幢大廈升降機缺少防火門框組件。
body: 機電工程署周一表示，檢查發現由臺中電梯安裝的升降機再有186幢大廈缺少門框組件，累計總數達338幢。
根據署方周一下午二時的最新抽查結果，除較早公布的兩個租者置其屋計劃屋邨外，上述338幢均為私人樓宇，升降機由臺中負責。署方指已完成臺中負責的樓宇檢查，並會繼續檢查其他註冊承辦商的工程。
有關組件屬防火門系統一部分，旨在限制火勢及煙霧蔓延。署方早前表示升降機仍可安全運作，並已指令承辦商自費補裝缺少組件。
